title: Review B2 (T-0017): executor routing via pick_executor, per-executor -m, quota-group cooldowns, run-log fields
spec: Adversarial review of the T-0017 diff against its acceptance criteria (skill adversarial-review). Focus: (1) executor.start picks by the task's real complexity and passes exactly that executor's model to `-m`; reply() reuses the recorded executor and never re-picks; (2) a usage-limit error cools the executor's whole quota_group and codex_available(complexity) turns False for all of them; running/day_tasks increments and decrements are balanced on every path including timeout and exceptions (finally blocks); (3) log_run entries from executor.py and spawn.py carry executor and complexity, and the token key is normalized to cache_read_input_tokens without losing the Codex value; (4) legacy pool.codex fields still keep status() meaningful, or are removed consistently with pool.py's bridge; (5) concurrent Pool() instances: does any new code make the last-writer-wins state clobbering worse; (6) tests assert behaviour, not implementation. Return ONLY the review JSON {"verdict":"approve|request_changes","comments":[{"path":"","line":0,"issue":"","severity":"low|med|high"}]}; under 3,000 chars.
acceptance: each high-severity comment names a concrete failing input

comments.issue: pool.pick_executor(...) does not exist. orchestrator/pool.py has no pick_executor, executors, cooldown_executor, Executor class, scores, or _legacy_executor — none were added by this diff and none exist anywhere in the repo (grep confirms zero hits) or in .orchestrator/pool.toml (no [[executors]] table). Reproduced directly: creating an execute task and calling executor.start(task_id, prompt) raises AttributeError: 'Pool' object has no attribute 'pick_executor'. Every new test that exercises this path fails the same way (Executors test class, test_start_routes_through_pick_executor, test_usage_limit_cools_the_whole_quota_group, test_run_log_carries_executor_and_complexity) — verified by applying the diff and running them.

reply() has the same missing dependency: pool.executors.get(...) and pool._legacy_executor() are undefined, so codex_reply() on any task raises AttributeError before it can check cooldown or max_parallel — e.g. reply('T-1', 'fix x') on a task with a codex_thread set crashes instead of holding.

Pool.status() still only returns {accounts, codex} (no update in this diff). tests.Cli.test_status expects an 'executors' key with 7 rows / 4 enabled, so cli.main() output fails that assertion — the diff's own test suite can't pass without a pool.py change that isn't part of this scoped diff.

No [[executors]] table was added. test_missing_table_synthesizes_legacy_row does `{k: v for k, v in P.config().items() if k != 'executors'}` expecting to strip a real 'executors' key to exercise the legacy-row fallback; since the key never existed, the filter is a no-op and the test doesn't exercise the intended synthesize-legacy-row behavior at all.
